title: Report-only invariant is not enforced by tool grants
description: Bare, unscoped Bash grants in agents/reviso-verifier.md:4, agents/reviso-finder-history.md:4, agents/reviso-finder-prior-reviews.md:4, and commands/review.md:4 allow subagents to run arbitrary commands (git commit, rm, curl, etc.), violating the report-only invariant. Pre-approves Bash(git branch:*) which permits destructive writes. Violates SECURITY.md requirements for handling untrusted diff/message input.

title: Untracked-file findings anchor to wrong path
description: Script does not cd to repo root. git diff -U0 emits repo-root-relative paths but git ls-files --others and git diff --no-index emit cwd-relative paths. Invoking from subdirectory causes untracked file hits to report unresolvable paths while tracked files resolve correctly. Fix: add cd to git root before computing MB.
